description: Use this after search_spots/recommend_spot (or when the user names a specific place) to get everything about ONE spot by slug: address, structured opening hours, Wi-Fi/outlets/noise/calls with the evidence behind each, best time to go, access tips (parking, purchase rules), approved community check-ins, credited creator posts, and links to the venue, Google Maps and Yelp.

slug.description: Spot slug from search_spots or recommend_spot, e.g. "pop-cafe"

name: get_spot
title: Get full details for one work spot
